what: When an intervention's registry name contains a comma, the Changes tab cannot show where one name ends and the next begins. In a walk where the record split "Interferon alfa-2b, recombinant" into "Interferon alfa-2b" and "recombinant", the card read Removed "Interferon alfa-2b, recombinant" and Added "Interferon alfa-2b, recombinant": the same words on both lines, so the analyst sees a drug apparently removed and re-added. A single name with a comma also reads as two drugs. I am not sure the owner counts this as a defect: the old Previously / Now card joined names the same way, but the new card's job is to name each intervention that moved. The cause is that the Removed and Added lines join names with a comma and a space, while the folded Unchanged names each get their own line.
